decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered 12/021-01 Sheets 1 and 2, 12/021 Location and Block Plans, Design and Access Statement, Structural Design Philosophy, Method Statement, Site Investigation Report, Hydro-geological Review and Floor Risk Assessment, Received 30 July 2012, 12/021-02B Sheets 1 and 2, Received 21 September 2012 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Hydro-geological Review and Flood Risk Assessment produced and provided with the application and the basement shall not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used for sleeping accommodation.

Condition : 7 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Method Statement and Site Investigation produced and provided with the application.

Condition : 8 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.
description: Creation of new basement level under the footprint of the existing building with a front lightwell and external stair access to the rear garden
